India Constructs First Rock Dam on Indus River in Ladakh

India has constructed its first rock dam on the Indus River at Upshi in Ladakh. This development comes amid reports that India has put the Indus Waters Treaty in abeyance. The dam, built without cement or concrete, aims to boost irrigation and water supply in the region. Coverage indicates the water level behind the dam has risen by up to 10 feet.
